name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations
description: Stops Windows from converting exclusive fullscreen games to borderless flip-model. Restores true exclusive fullscreen (lower latency, correct alt-tab behavior per game).

name: Disable Game Bar pop-ups
description: Prevents the Game Bar (Win+G) overlay and its 'how do you want to open this' popups from appearing in games.

name: Disable Game DVR
description: Stops Windows from recording your gameplay in the background (GameDVR_Enabled=0 + policy AllowGameDVR=0). Removes constant background capture overhead in every game.

name: Disable mouse acceleration
description: Turns off 'Enhance pointer precision' (MouseSpeed=0, thresholds=0). Raw, predictable aim - the first thing any FPS player changes.

name: Ensure Game Mode is on
description: Windows prioritizes the foreground game (fewer background tasks while gaming). On by default in current builds - this makes it explicit.

name: Foreground priority boost
description: Win32PrioritySeparation=38 (0x26): short fixed time slices with a 3:1 boost for the foreground app. The standard low-latency scheduler setting for games and audio work.

name: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling
description: Lets the GPU manage its own memory scheduling (HwSchMode=2). Reduces latency on supported GPUs (NVIDIA GTX 10xx+, AMD RX 5000+). Not shown if your GPU/driver doesn't expose it.

name: Silence Game Bar notifications
description: Turns off the achievement and recording popups that can steal focus and drop frames in full-screen games.

name: Add 'End task' to the taskbar menu
description: Adds an 'End task' entry to the taskbar right-click menu, so a frozen app can be killed without opening Task Manager.

name: Align the taskbar to the left
description: Moves the Start button and taskbar icons from the center to the left edge, like Windows 10.

name: Cut menu and taskbar animations
description: Removes the fade and slide animations from menus and taskbar buttons. Windows feels immediate, which matters most on older hardware.

name: Disable Aero Shake
description: Stops grabbing and shaking a window from minimizing everything else. Usually an accident, never useful.

name: Disable transparency effects
description: Turns off acrylic/blur effects across the shell. Frees a small amount of GPU and RAM on low-end systems.

name: Enable dark mode
description: Switches Windows and app themes to dark (AppsUseLightTheme and SystemUsesLightTheme are both 0).

name: Fast tooltip hover time
description: MouseHoverTime 400ms -> 8ms: tooltips appear almost instantly. Purely a responsiveness nicety.

name: Hide notification banners
description: Keeps notifications in the Action Center but stops them from sliding in over whatever you are doing. Focus assist style, without the schedule.

name: Hide the chat icon
description: Removes the Teams chat icon from the taskbar on Windows 11 builds that still show one.

name: Hide the Task View button
description: Removes the Task View button from the taskbar. Win+Tab still opens Task View.

name: Hide Widgets
description: Removes the taskbar Widgets button and stops the widget feed host from running in the background (TaskbarDa=0).

name: Instant menu delay
description: MenuShowDelay 400ms -> 0ms: context menus and drop-downs open instantly.

name: Performance visual effects
description: Sets 'Best performance' visual effects: disables window/taskbar animations and selection rectangle fade, keeps font smoothing and thumbnails (known-good UserPreferencesMask 90 12 03 80 10 00 00 00).

name: Show file name extensions
description: Clears HideFileExt, so known file types show their extension in File Explorer. Fewer double-extension surprises.

name: Show hidden files
description: Shows files and folders marked hidden in File Explorer. Protected operating system files stay hidden unless you also enable them in Folder Options.

name: Show search as an icon only
description: Shrinks the taskbar search box down to the small icon. The search page itself is unchanged.

name: Show seconds on the taskbar clock
description: Adds seconds to the taskbar clock, at the cost of a small extra repaint each second.

name: Turn NumLock on at sign-in
description: NumLock is on at the lock screen and right after sign-in.

name: Turn off lock screen Spotlight
description: Stops Windows from downloading rotating lock screen pictures. Saves a little background network and disk work, and the lock screen stays predictable.

name: Turn off the snap layouts flyout
description: Stops the snap layouts panel from appearing when you hover a window's maximize button. Snapping with the keyboard and drag still works.

name: Turn off the Sticky Keys shortcut
description: Stops five Shift presses from turning Sticky Keys on. The feature itself still works from the Accessibility settings.

name: Use the classic File Explorer context menu
description: Brings back the full classic right-click menu instead of the compact Windows 11 one. Sign out or restart Explorer to see it; revert removes the override.

name: Boost 'Games' multimedia task
description: Raises the priority Windows gives the 'Games' multimedia task (SystemProfile\Tasks\Games): Priority 6, GPU Priority 8, High scheduling. The classic CPU/network latency tweak for game processes.

name: Disable Nagle's algorithm
description: Sets TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1 on all physical network interfaces. Reduces small-packet latency in online games. Negligible impact on throughput.

name: Disable network throttling
description: NetworkThrottlingIndex=0xFFFFFFFF removes the 10 packets/ms multimedia throttle that can cap network throughput during multimedia workloads (incl. games).

name: Disable the SMB1 file sharing protocol
description: SMB1 is the 1990s file sharing protocol behind WannaCry. Modern Windows and NAS boxes use SMB2 or SMB3, so turning it off closes an attack surface with no everyday cost.

name: Drop TCP timestamps
description: Keeps window scaling but stops adding a timestamp to every TCP segment. Slightly less per-packet overhead on fast links, no effect on normal browsing.

name: Release the reserved QoS bandwidth
description: Windows keeps 20 percent of the link for QoS by default. Setting the limit to zero hands that slice back to normal traffic; QoS still works when an app asks for it.

name: Reserve less CPU for multimedia
description: SystemResponsiveness=10 (default 20): halves the CPU slice the multimedia scheduler keeps for background audio/video work, leaving more for the foreground app.

name: Stop Windows Update P2P uploads
description: DODownloadMode=0: updates download straight from Microsoft instead of being shared peer-to-peer. Stops background upload traffic that competes with games and calls.

name: Turn off Wi-Fi Sense sharing
description: Stops Windows from offering to share Wi-Fi credentials with contacts and from pulling suggested hotspots. Nothing you joined is forgotten.

name: Disable DiagTrack (Connected User Experiences and Telemetry)
description: The telemetry service. Collects and uploads usage data to Microsoft. Zero user-facing functionality is lost.

name: Disable Distributed Link Tracking Client
description: Tracks shortcuts and file moves across volumes for roaming profiles. Pointless on a single-PC setup.

name: Disable Downloaded Maps Manager
description: Background service for the offline Maps app. If you don't use Maps, it's dead weight.

name: Disable Fax
description: Nobody faxes. Not even in 2026.

name: Disable Media Player Network Sharing
description: Shares your media library over the network via UPnP. Only needed if you stream from this PC to a TV or console.

name: Disable Phone Service
description: Brokers calls and SMS between Windows and a paired phone. Dead weight unless you actually link a phone to the PC.

name: Disable Print Spooler
description: Only choose this if you never print. Also closes a well-known escalation path (PrintNightmare).

name: Disable Remote Registry
description: Allows remote machines to edit your registry. Disabled by default attack-surface-wise on most setups; nothing local uses it.

name: Disable Retail Demo Service
description: Shop-floor demo mode for retail stores. Removed on retail machines by the store; harmless to disable if present.

name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
description: Preloads frequently-used apps into RAM. Debated: can help HDD systems, often causes disk churn mid-game. Skip if you're on a slow HDD and like fast app launches.

name: Disable the legacy routing service
description: Turns off Routing and Remote Access, the service behind dial-up and old VPN setups. Home networks and modern VPN clients do not use it.

name: Disable WAP Push Message Routing (dmwappushservice)
description: Legacy SMS/WAP enterprise management channel. Not used on consumer PCs.

name: Disable Windows Error Reporting
description: Sends crash dumps to Microsoft and queues report uploads. Apps still crash the same way; you just stop paying the background upload and disk cost.

name: Park the diagnostic policy service
description: Sets the Diagnostic Policy Service to manual. Windows troubleshooting wizards still work; the always-on background diagnostics stop.

name: Park the UPnP device host
description: Sets the UPnP device host to manual. Only needed when sharing media to a TV or console, which starts it on demand.

name: Park the Xbox accessory service
description: Sets the Xbox controller accessory service to manual. Wired and Bluetooth controllers still work; the service starts when a game asks for it.

name: Park the Xbox Live auth service
description: Sets the Xbox Live authentication service to manual. Signing into the Xbox app or a Game Pass title starts it again on demand.

name: Park the Xbox networking service
description: Sets the Xbox Live networking service to manual. Only needed for Xbox multiplayer and the Xbox app, which restart it on demand.

name: Park the Xbox save sync service
description: Sets the Xbox game save service to manual. Saves still work locally; cloud sync starts again the next time a game needs it.

name: Block WPBT firmware execution
description: Blocks the Windows Platform Binary Table, which lets motherboard firmware drop an executable into Windows on every boot. Revert removes the block.

name: Clear the Start menu recommendations
description: Turns off the suggested apps and account nudges in the Start menu. Your pinned apps and the app list are untouched.

name: Debloat Brave with policies
description: Turns off Brave Rewards, wallet, VPN, AI chat, Tor, sync, metrics, background mode, News, Talk, Web Discovery and Speedreader through policy. Revert puts the policies back.

name: Debloat Edge with policies
description: Turns off Edge shopping, recommendations, personalization reporting, feedback, collections, followed creators, widgets, search suggestions, sponsored error pages, asset delivery, mini menu, wallet donations and Discover. Revert puts the policies back.

name: Deny app access to your location
description: Sets the system location consent to Deny. Apps that need it can still ask, and Maps still works while the setting is on.

name: Disable activity history & timeline upload
description: Turns off activity feed collection and Microsoft-account upload of your app usage timeline.

name: Disable advertising ID
description: Stops apps from using a unique ID to build an ad profile of you.

name: Disable Bing in Start search
description: Start menu searches local files and apps only: no web results and nothing sent to Bing.

name: Disable consumer features & app pushes
description: DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures=1 (HKCU and the HKLM policy hive): no automatic installs of promoted Store apps, no suggested content in the Start menu or the shell. The single most effective anti-bloat policy.

name: Disable Copilot
description: Removes the Copilot taskbar entry and disables the built-in Copilot experience via policy. Doesn't uninstall the Copilot app - use Debloat for that.

name: Disable feedback requests
description: Stops Windows from asking you for feedback about features (Siuf: zero requests per period).

name: Disable inking & typing personalization
description: Stops Windows from sending what you type and write to Microsoft to build a local personalization dictionary.

name: Disable OneDrive ads in File Explorer
description: Hides the 'Get more storage' / sync-provider banners that appear in Explorer's navigation pane.

name: Disable Recall (AI snapshotting)
description: DisableAIDataAnalysis=1 policy: turns off the Recall feature that periodically screenshots your activity on Copilot+ PCs.

name: Disable suggestions & silent app installs
description: No 'suggested content' in Start/Settings/lock screen, no tips notifications, and no auto-installing 'recommended' apps from the Store.

name: Disable tailored experiences
description: Stops Microsoft from using your diagnostic data to personalise tips, ads and recommendations shown in Windows.

name: Disable web results in Start search
description: Start search becomes local-only: no Bing queries, no web suggestions, no cloud content. Noticeably faster and no keystrokes leave the PC.

name: Free up reserved storage
description: Frees the several GB Windows reserves for updates. Updates still need free space, so keep some. Revert restores the reserve.

name: Hide recent & frequent folders
description: Clears the 'Recent files' and 'Frequent folders' lists from Explorer's Home and Quick Access (ShowRecent=0, ShowFrequent=0, Start_TrackDocs=0).

name: Keep clipboard history on this PC
description: Stops the clipboard from syncing to your Microsoft account and from uploading copied items. Local copy and paste keeps working.

name: Remove OneDrive
description: Runs the bundled OneDriveSetup.exe /uninstall: removes the OneDrive app from this machine and stops it from starting with Windows. Files in your OneDrive folder are not deleted. Reverting reinstalls the app, and you sign in again.

name: Set telemetry to minimum
description: AllowTelemetry=0 policy. On Pro+ this is 'Security level' (minimal); on Home it reduces to the required-data minimum. Stacks with disabling DiagTrack.

name: Skip Edge first run and preload
description: Hides the Edge welcome flow and stops the browser from staying in memory after you close it.

name: Stop app-launch tracking
description: Start_TrackProgs=0: Windows stops recording which programs you launch to 'improve' Start and search results.

name: Stop device metadata downloads
description: Stops Windows downloading vendor apps and metadata for connected devices. Revert allows it again.

name: Stop suggested content in Settings
description: Removes the promotional cards and app suggestions Windows shows on the Settings home page.

name: Turn off typing insights
description: Stops Windows from collecting a local sample of what you type to improve suggestions and autocorrect.

name: Disable Fast Startup
description: HiberbootEnabled=0: a real shutdown instead of a hybrid hibernate. Fixes 'my settings reset' and dual-boot/update weirdness, and makes driver changes actually take effect on boot.

name: Disable hibernation
description: Runs 'powercfg /h off': deletes hiberfil.sys (~40% of your RAM size) and disables Fast Startup. Frees disk; cold boots are unaffected.

name: Disable power throttling (EcoQoS)
description: PowerThrottlingOff=1: stops Windows from silently capping background processes to low-power cores/efficiency mode. Useful for encode, compile and stream workloads; costs a little battery.

name: Keep the CPU in boost mode
description: Sets the processor performance boost mode to Aggressive for the active plan. Short bursts finish sooner, at the cost of a little heat.

name: Keep USB devices awake
description: Stops Windows from suspending USB ports to save power. Fixes controllers, audio interfaces and external drives that drop out or need a replug.

name: Ultimate Performance power plan
description: Activates the hidden Ultimate Performance plan (no aggressive CPU parking, no display sleep timers). Modern CPUs still downclock fine with it.

name: Use classic sleep instead of Modern Standby
description: Forces the S3 sleep state on machines that support it. Classic sleep resumes faster and keeps network and audio devices working after wake.
